fail-on-demand turns red only if `.fail-me` exists at the root; no phase may create it. A red check is re-run with `legion gh -- run rerun <run-id> --failed`, never fixed by a new commit or by bringing in main.

The spec Errors row `file already exists on the default branch` is currently false (absent at 24db0529); if another run lands smoke/LEGSMOKE-349.md first, the implementer stops and reports on the issue instead of overwriting.
